blurb: Guests rent and sail bareboat yachts of various models and sizes from Rock Hall, Maryland. The fleet includes well-maintained, luxuriously equipped sailboats. Charters range from weekend to week-long durations with options for mid-week specials and night-before boarding.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to reserve, balance due 2 weeks prior to arrival · Deposit refundable less $75 cancellation fee up to 45 days before departure; after 45 days refund only if substitute booking obtained · Security deposit required per boat, refundable; $75 non-refundable security surcharge added to charter fee · Night before boarding allowed after 6pm except for mid-week specials, no extra charge · Charters may depart any day except Sundays and holidays · Haven Harbour Marina, on Swan Creek, Rock Hall, MD
